phase_name: The lint consumes the same definition

objectives.description: Rewrite collect_identities (Check C) and Check D's existence loop to resolve through the bridge in one batch call
Delete normalize_identity(), rewrite D4/D5 header notes
Make a bridge failure fatal (exit 2, named error, line-count check)
Extend test suite with agreement, ~/-ineligibility, and bridge-failure cases

approaches_tried.approach: Route only Check C (fragment coverage) through the shared module, leave Check D (existence) on its own bash-side normalize_identity
approaches_tried.reason: Phase 3's own verification criterion requires grep -c 'normalize_identity' to be 0 outside the header note -- leaving Check D on a second, independent normalization function would fail that literally. Unified both checks onto the one shared module/bridge instead, accepting the (practically unreachable) behavior change that an absolute non-.claude/, non-~/ path is now also skipped by Check D's existence check, consistent with the carve-out.

deviations.description: Rewrite collect_identities to resolve through one bridge invocation
deviations.reason: Also unified Check D's existence-check loop onto the same shared inventory/bridge resolution, not just Check C's collect_identities, since the plan's own grep-count-0 verification criterion requires the bash-side normalize_identity function to be gone entirely, not merely refactored out of Check C alone.
deviations.annotation: *(completed: Check D's existing identity-adjacent existence loop was also unified onto the shared module, not left on bash-side normalize_identity, so the grep-count-0 verification criterion holds literally)*

notes: Added HOOK_IDENTITY_CLI_OVERRIDE env var (test-only escape hatch) so the bridge-failure test case never has to touch the real bridge file.
